subject: Switch suggest_links to semantic scorer + cross-encoder rerank (drop lexical scoreMatches)
description:
Consolidate the create-task link suggester onto the SAME retrieval core /search uses, replacing the lexical-only scorer. Scope: `suggest_links` only — do NOT touch the cloud search box (#cloudSearchInput).

CHANGES in `suggestForTask` (daemon.js:1278):
1. Replace base ranking `scoreMatches(g, target)` with `scoreMatchesSemantic(g, target, targetVec)` (daemon.js:1308) — pass the target task's embedding (tasks carry .vecs; reuse the nodeVecs/maxCosine path scoreMatchesSemantic already uses). Per-pair lexical fallback already exists inside scoreMatchesSemantic for vec-less nodes, preserving back-compat.
2. Make the cross-encoder rerank DEFAULT-ON for this path (today it is gated behind ORCH_RERANK at daemon.js:1284). Mirror the /search default-on pattern (routes/graph.js:374-382): fire unless explicitly disabled; NULL-SAFE — if rerank() returns null (sidecar unavailable) keep cosine order; if cosine unavailable fall back to lexical. Keep ORCH_RERANK=0/off as a force-disable.
3. PRESERVE the `shared` token list in each suggestion (the agent's explainability evidence — why a link was proposed). Compute lexical overlap for DISPLAY even when ranking semantically.
4. RECALIBRATE the duplicate flag. scoreMatchesSemantic currently flags duplicate via `score >= SUGGEST_DUP_THRESHOLD` (daemon.js:1325), but that constant is tuned on the LEXICAL scale; cosine is a different scale (cf. SEMANTIC_AUTOWIRE_THRESHOLD=0.55). Introduce/use a semantic-scale dup threshold so the near-duplicate warning fires correctly on cosine, not at the lexical bar. Document the chosen value + rationale.

REVIEW MODEL UNCHANGED: suggest_links candidates still return to the AGENT, who asserts the edge directly (origin:'asserted', overlay.js:33). No runtime edge-judge tier is added — the agent is the reviewer. This task only improves candidate QUALITY.

TESTS: update test/suggest-rerank.test.js to cover (a) semantic ranking is used by default, (b) rerank default-on with null-safe fallback, (c) shared-token evidence still present, (d) the recalibrated semantic dup threshold. Run the suite green before complete_task. Commit all changes onto the orch/attempt branch BEFORE complete_task.
